name: Voice Clone Impersonation
description: An attacker uses a deepfake voice clone of a family member to urgently request a payment, exploiting emotional trust and time pressure.

name: CEO Fraud Deepfake
description: A video deepfake of a company executive authorizes a fraudulent wire transfer, bypassing normal financial controls.

name: Romance Scam Automation
description: An AI chatbot manages 100+ parallel romantic relationships at scale to build trust and extract money from victims.

name: Customer Service Impersonation
description: An AI voice bot impersonates customer service to extract credentials and account access from target victims.

name: Investment Scam Bot
description: An AI system delivers personalized investment pitches tailored to each victim to convince them to hand over money.

name: Charity Fraud at Scale
description: AI-generated fake charity campaigns solicit donations from a large audience, disappearing once funds are collected.

name: Deepfake Identity Verification
description: A real-time deepfake video feed is used to bypass video-based KYC identity verification checks.

name: Synthetic Identity Creation
description: A synthetic identity is assembled from a GAN-generated face and an AI-written personal profile to pass KYC.

name: Document Forgery Automation
description: AI-generated fake IDs and passports are produced to bypass document-based identity verification.

name: Account Farming Botnet
description: A botnet automates the creation and aging of accounts to build a clean history before exploitation.

name: Biometric Spoofing
description: Fingerprint or facial biometric authentication is bypassed using physical or digital spoofing techniques.

name: UPI Intent Hijacking
description: A malicious mobile app intercepts UPI payment intents and redirects them to an attacker-controlled account.

name: QR Code Poisoning
description: Fake QR codes redirect victims' payments to attacker-controlled payment endpoints.

name: BNPL Identity Abuse
description: A synthetic identity is used to open a buy-now-pay-later line and immediately max out the limit.

name: Cross-Border Arbitrage
description: Currency conversion and FX-rate discrepancies in cross-border payments are exploited for illicit profit.

name: Subscription Creep
description: Multiple small recurring subscriptions are charged to victims who do not notice or actively cancel them.

name: Prompt Injection Fraud
description: A prompt injection manipulates an AI chatbot into revealing credentials or sensitive payment information.

name: Model Extraction Attack
description: An attacker probes the fraud-detection API with crafted inputs to reverse-engineer and steal the model.

name: Adversarial Transaction Crafting
description: ML-crafted transaction patterns are generated to evade the detection model's learned decision boundaries.

name: LLM-Jacking
description: Attackers hijack LLM-integrated payment flows (e.g. Siri, Alexa, banking chat bots) to issue fraudulent payments.

name: Autonomous Fraud Agent
description: An autonomous AI agent independently plans and executes multi-step fraud campaigns without human intervention.

name: Urgency Engineering
description: The attacker engineers artificial urgency - countdown timers, limited-time offers, emergency pleas - to pressure victims into authorizing transactions before they can verify legitimacy.

name: Trust Calibration
description: The attacker calibrates trust signals such as fake reviews, verified badges, and social proof so victims perceive the interaction as legitimate.

name: Timing Optimization
description: Transactions are timed to coincide with victim behavioral rhythms - late-night hours, paydays, or moments of low vigilance - to maximize fraud success.

name: Multi-Channel Orchestration
description: Fraud is orchestrated across multiple concurrent channels (SMS, email, voice, push) so the victim cannot reconcile a single coherent narrative.
